_readme: Lead-editable rules for the voice agent's turn guard (conversation/agent/turn_guard.py). Contains NO scripture. The guard runs before the model on a child's turn and knows only three sections: 'safety' (a serious disclosure: the model is told to comfort and a flag is recorded), 'level_d' (a personal case or a religious ruling: a warm referral to a parent or scholar) and 'level_c' (creed and disputed topics: a warm referral, no views described). Each rule has 'en' and/or 'ar' = a list of GROUPS; the rule fires when EVERY group matches, and a group matches when ANY of its phrases appears in the child's message (whole words; multi-word phrases must appear in order). Arabic is normalised at load (tashkeel stripped, alef/ya/ta-marbuta unified), the clitics ال/و/ب/ل/ف are tolerated and a final plural ون also matches وا, so write plain spelling. A phrase '@name' inside a group is replaced by the shared list 'vocab.name' for that language. Order of evaluation: safety (if several fire, a rule with notify_parent=false wins, else the first), level_c rules marked before_d, level_d, then the other level_c rules; no match means the model answers alone. Optional per rule: 'window' (max tokens spanned by the matched phrases), 'unless' (phrases that veto the rule), 'notify_parent' (safety rules: false = this rule wins when several fire, so its home-harm reply is used; since hk/12g every safety hit alerts the parent, there is no staff-only path), 'before_d' (level_c: wins over the personal-case rules), 'flag_type' (safety rules). Keep generic words out of single-group rules: a false positive sends a child to a referral.

vocab._note: Shared word lists. Write '@name' inside a rule group to include the list for that language. Words only.

level_c.note: two people/scholars say different things: who is right
'X says it is haram but Y says it is fine': two opposite claims, scholars or people differ
'one sheikh said ... another sheikh said ...': scholars differ
'only our group will be saved': contested, scholars differ
the afterlife of a friend or neighbour of another faith: scholars differ in detail, refer, and serve no items

retrieval_synonyms._note: Extra keywords per value slug, merged with values.json keywords when the index is built (plural/verb forms, dialect, phrasings). Words only, no scripture.

weak_keywords._note: Person and role words that must not pick a value on their own. A keyword (from values.json or retrieval_synonyms) whose normalised text is listed here counts toward its value only when the same message also has a value cue: a non-weak keyword of that value, or one of the behaviour / question 'cues' below. A message whose only hits are weak keywords serves no items (mode NONE unless another rule fires). '@family' includes vocab.family. Words only, no scripture. Switch off with the env flag RETRIEVAL_WEAK_KEYWORDS=0 (the veto stays on). 'veto': a message with one of these words (death, fear, secrecy, hospital or serious illness, hitting, bullying) matches no value from its own words, whatever the cue; values the model names still count.
